## About & Professional Summary
Trịnh Hoàng Tú (thtcsec) is a Cybersecurity student and Software Engineer specializing in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Computer Vision, Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps, Serverless architectures, Microservices, and Network Security.

- **Current Roles:** 
  - **AI Engineer** @ VETC (Aug 2026 – Present) | Developing Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), Computer Vision pipelines for traffic camera analytics, real-time traffic density detection, road surveillance, and IoT sensor microservices.
  - **Software Engineer (Backend) Intern** @ Grab (Aug 2026 – Present) | High-performance Java microservices & regional backend architecture.
  - **AI Infra & Cloud Solutions Engineer** @ Next Step Technology Solutions (Jun 2026 – Present) | Cloudflare Workers AI, RAG knowledge retrieval, serverless pipelines.
  - **FCAJ Cloud Trainee - Cloud Security Builder** @ AWS Study Group VN (Sep 2025 – Present) | Serverless SOAR, Step Functions, GuardDuty incident automation.
- **Education:** 
  - Bachelor of Cybersecurity @ HUFLIT (GPA: 3.50/4.00)

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

## Technical Skillset
- **Languages:** C#, Java, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, C++
- **Backend & Frameworks:** ASP.NET Core 10, FastAPI, Java Spring/Microservices, Node.js, REST APIs, SignalR, Redis Streams
- **Frontend & Web:** React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Recharts
- **AI / Computer Vision / ML:** PyTorch, YOLOv11/v12, TensorRT, INT8 Quantization, Drain3, LogBERT, TCN, Transformers, OpenCV
- **Cloud & DevOps:** Docker, Kubernetes, Nginx, AWS (Lambda, Step Functions, GuardDuty, EventBridge), Cloudflare Ecosystem (Workers, Pages, D1, R2, KV, Vectorize, Workers AI, Zero Trust), Terraform
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MongoDB, Qdrant, OpenSearch, Firebase, Supabase
- **Security & IoT:** Suricata IDS, Wazuh SIEM, SOC/SOAR incident automation, WAF, Zero Trust Access, V2X Telemetry, Traffic Analytics

## Featured Projects & Systems
- **Bảo An Auto — Zalo Mini App Garage Management & Multi-Branch SaaS**: Mobile garage operation management platform built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, and Recharts. Features multi-branch role-based permissions (Admin, Manager, Mechanic, Receptionist), POS service invoicing, and financial reporting.
- **sdn-its-resilience-ai**: Lightweight research framework for V2X network reliability, edge telemetry, and safety-aware SDN mitigation with Hybrid TCN-GRU anomaly detection (Tsinghua University IEDE).
- **OrangeCloud Insights** (https://blog.orangecloud.vn): Serverless tech intelligence crawler and AI summarizer using Cloudflare Workflows, D1, R2, Vectorize, and OpenAI API.
- **EnterpriseRAG**: Production hybrid RAG platform combining Qdrant dense search, OpenSearch BM25, CrossEncoder reranking, and document ACLs.
- **QUASAR** (https://github.com/Muhammad-Rafif-Irfan/QUASAR): Classical-Quantum hybrid logistics routing engine combining Google OR-Tools with 127-qubit IBM QPU QAOA algorithms (QC4SG 2026 Finalist).
- **SecureCoating-Vision**: Multi-source data fusion vision inspection system for real-time coating defect detection (Tsinghua University AI + Materials Competition).
- **Foundry**: AI-Powered Engineering Review & Code Intelligence Platform with ASP.NET Core 10, pgvector, and Next.js 15.
- **CTSmartCam**: Intelligent surveillance camera ecosystem with YOLOv11 LPR, Redis Streams event pipeline, and SignalR live feeds.
- **Multi-Cloud Serverless SOAR**: Event-driven incident response automation built across AWS and GCP using Step Functions and Cloud Workflows.
- **toanvotruongtoan.com**: Production LMS with Gemini-powered automated exams, serving hundreds of students.
